javax.microedition.broadcast.connection
Interface BroadcastConnectionListener

public interface BroadcastConnectionListener

BroadcastConnectionListener listens for the events indicating the availability and updates of a broadcast connection. It is registered via the addListener method.

See broadcast connection examples for some usage examples.

Implementations use constants specified here to post the events. Applications can test the event by using "==" operator instead of String.equals() method.
